name: Prasonisi
notes: Isthmus with two sides: waves on the west side, flatter water on the east side. Meltemi (NW) May–Sept, often strong; schools on site.

name: Theologos
notes: North-west coast near the airport; meltemi side-onshore, choppy. Schools on site in summer.

name: Marmari
notes: Long sandy beach on the north coast; meltemi (NW) side-onshore, chop and small waves. Several kite centres, good for learning.

name: Afiartis – Makry Gialos
notes: Bays near the airport (Chicken Bay, Devil's Bay): very strong and consistent meltemi (NW, offshore-ish over low land), flat water. Experienced riders; centres on site.

name: Mikri Vigla
notes: Meltemi (N) side-shore; flat-ish water on the south side, waves on the north side. Kite centre on site.

name: Pounta
notes: Channel towards Antiparos: meltemi (N) side-shore, flat to choppy water. Kite centre on site; watch the ferry route.

name: Golden Beach (Chrysi Akti)
notes: Long beach on the east coast; meltemi side-shore, chop. Windsurf and kite centres.

name: Korfos
notes: Bay near Mykonos town; meltemi (N) side-offshore, flat water. Kite school in summer.

name: Keros
notes: Wide shallow bay on the east coast; meltemi (N) side-shore, flat to choppy water. Kite and windsurf club on site.

name: Lefkada – Agios Ioannis
notes: Beach next to Lefkada town and the windmills; afternoon NW thermal (maistro), onshore with waves. Schools on site.

name: Kouremenos (Palaikastro)
notes: Funnelled meltemi (N–NW), side-offshore and gusty; flat to choppy water. Mostly a windsurf spot, experienced riders.

name: Epanomi – Potamos
notes: Sandy spit south of Thessaloniki; works with N–NW and S winds, flat water inside the spit. Schools on site.

name: Angelochori
notes: Shallow water by the Angelochori lagoon west of the airport; flat, good for learning. Works with S and N winds.

name: Loutsa (Artemida)
notes: East Attica; meltemi (N–NE) side-shore, chop. Popular Athens spot with schools.

name: Schinias
notes: Long beach in the Marathon bay; meltemi (N–NE) side-offshore, flat water near shore. Experienced riders on gusty days.
